stepBody: Above, we drew $$R$$ bootstrap replicates. If we draw many more sets of bootstrap replicates, say $$M=10000$$ sets of $$R$$ replicates each, and calculate $$10000$$ $$50$$ percent confidence intervals for the population variance the same way we did in the part above, then roughly $$50$$ percent of those intervals will contain the true population variance.
